title: LoadProgressV2
description:
A model load's progress: what moved, under which stage.

A record of its own (not two fields of the enum variant) so a channel that
carries only a load's progress, such as a shared GPU worker's waiting
load, is typed to carry nothing else.

stage.description: Stable stage name (for a phase, without any edge suffix).

LoadMeasureV2.description: What a model load's progress event measures.

oneOf.description: A model download's measured growth so far, in KiB.

grown_kib.description: KiB the download's cache trees have grown since it started.

edge.description: Which end of the phase this event marks.

PhaseEdgeV2.description: Which end of a phase a [`LoadMeasureV2::Phase`] event marks.
